about_the_game:
Tiny Garden lets you cultivate a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations. Grow a variety of plants, trade them for unique furniture, and customize your garden in this calming mix of farming, puzzle-solving, and strategy. With no scores or time limits, it’s all about relaxing, experimenting, and letting your creativity bloom!

The Supporter's Pack is full of memories we have made along our journey of creating Tiny Garden. We want to thank everyone who has supported us throughout development! 

INCLUDED IN SUPPORTER'S PACK DLC:

  • OG Logo Sticker - A throwback for the ones who have been around since the beginning! 

  • Candyfloss Clouds Ambience - A peaceful pink cloud vibe for your Tiny Garden playthrough (featuring some OG textures!) 

  • Bakewell Colourway - A colour scheme for you case / furniture / plants that you just want to nibble!
